# Source fixtures

These files contain selected, unchanged epigram subtrees from
PerseusDL/canonical-greekLit commit `790c84289edbdbe289dd7b752bfea29f0af4299d`:

- `ap-6-source.xml`: AP 6.321, 6.324–327, 6.329, from
  `data/tlg7000/tlg001/tlg7000.tlg001.perseus-grc6.xml`.
- `ap-7-source.xml`: AP 7.547–550, from

The original TEI headers and containing edition/book attributes are retained.
Other poems were removed and XML namespace serialization changed; Greek readings,
line numbers, speaker markup and other attributes within the selected units were
not changed. Source edition: W. R. Paton, *The Greek Anthology* (1916–1917).

The upstream TEI material retains CC BY-SA 4.0 licensing and its original
attribution; see `provenance/canonical-greekLit-license.md` and the TEI headers.
These fixtures test source structure and arithmetic, not textual emendations.
